proposed_contract_additions.semantics: Detach the markers plugin from its host series. ChartPanel detaches BEFORE removeSeries (clearAllIndicators at :2448). SeriesHandle.remove() already detaches internally; an explicit detach remains needed when the series survives and only the marks go.
Read back live series options (visible, priceScaleId). Magnet-crosshair and isRequestedPriceScaleApplied depend on this.
Read back scale mode/margins. Axis-wheel zoom inspects mode + scaleMargins (ChartPanel.tsx:7303).
The price scale this series is attached to. drawingPaneReadiness and axis-wheel zoom go through this.
Lookup a row by logical index. MismatchDirection.NearestRight finds the first visible bar for percent/indexed scales; paneSync uses min/max integer with nearest-left/right.
Visible price window. drawingPaneReadiness uses this as the scale-ready probe; axis-wheel zoom reads it before mutating.
Map a fractional logical index to CSS-px x. Drawing/SVG overlays (xOf, suite xi) depend on this.
Clear a programmatic crosshair. Idempotent if none is set.
Series currently living in this pane (magnet-crosshair candidate scan, drawing seriesForPane).
Per-pane price scale. applyPaneTickDensity writes tickMarkDensity onto every pane's right scale (ChartPanel.tsx:2232).
Toggle autoscale. Axis-dblclick reset (ChartPanel.tsx:7371), ChartFrameBar lock toggle, ChartSettingsModal Scales tab.
Return the series' current data array (ChartPanel e2e census slices the last 120 rows at :3774).
Resolve a calendar time to a (possibly nearest) logical index. paneSync converts a peer's time into the local axis.
Read back live chart options. ChartPanel uses layout.fontSize for the axis tag (ChartPanel.tsx:3767, :4550). Returns the owned EngineOptions shape.

proposed_contract_additions.signature: (price: number, time: EngineTime, series: SeriesHandle): void
proposed_contract_additions.semantics: Place the crosshair on a series at (time, price). LWC does not fire crosshairMove for this, so DOM labels listen via paneSync onCrosshair.
Inverse of logicalToCoordinate. Drawing hit-testing converts pointer x to a logical index.
Calendar (time-domain) visible window. Distinct from getVisibleLogicalRange. Pane-sync law: mirror a CALENDAR window, never bar indexes.
Set the visible window by calendar time (ChartFrameBar 1D/1W/1M/YTD keys). Distinct from setVisibleLogicalRange.
Plot-area width in CSS px. applyView (ChartPanel.tsx:3319) sizes a logical window from it.
Set the visible price window (axis-wheel zoom writes the zoomed range). Pointer-anchored: the value under the pointer stays fixed (<=1 CSS px).

proposed_contract_additions.signature: (range: EngineLogicalRange): { from: EngineTime; to: EngineTime } | null
proposed_contract_additions.semantics: Bars of this series that fall inside a logical range, with the first/last bar times. sessionShading uses this to iterate visible bars for session tint.
Live price-line inventory on this series. chartOwnershipCensus counts them (ChartPanel.tsx:3358) to detect unpooled lines.
Read back time-scale options (e2e hook __mmChartAxisOpts at ChartPanel.tsx:3766).
Mutate the existing pane watermark without detach+recreate. ChartPanel Effect 7 toggles visible/color this way (ChartPanel.tsx:9726); setWatermark replace-semantics would flash.
